name: Urza human mulligan and bottoming benchmark summary

deck_snapshot.historical_consistency: All 250 historical goldfishes and annotated hands are treated as the same deck snapshot except a tentative late Fugitive Droid-for-Codex Shredder trial in hands 24 and 34.
deck_snapshot.normalization: Hands 24 and 34 are evaluated as Codex Shredder for benchmark comparability; their recorded Fugitive Droid card is retained as provenance.

mulligan_semantics.description: Mulligan count is the number of fresh hands seen/redealt.

rating_semantics.warning: Do not compare equal numeric ratings across different keep sizes.

label_priority.secondary: actual London bottoms when exact state is reconstructable

source_notes.row_10: Unrecoverable internal mismatch: listed seven does not contain recorded bottoms and justification references Spellseeker. Permanently exclude from exact-state regression unless original source is rediscovered.
source_notes.row_30: Recovered missing seventh card: Swan Song.
source_notes.row_36: Recovered missing seventh card: Uthros Research Craft.
source_notes.rows_24_34: Recorded Fugitive Droid was a tentative late replacement for Codex Shredder. Benchmark-normalize these two hands to Codex Shredder while preserving the recorded card as provenance.
source_notes.row_15_counterfactual: Would Keep at=2 but two Would Bottom cards remain listed in the original sheet; optional label remains unresolved.

policy_themes_for_diagnostics_only: Fast Urza is not sufficient when post-Urza mana collapses.
Mana plus interaction without a value or win plan can still be a mulligan.
Colored and persistent mana quality matters separately from nominal mana quantity.
Interaction does not rescue every otherwise weak hand.
Plausible T4 conversion matters for several seven-card decisions.
Keep threshold changes with mulligan stage and retained-card count.
